test_automation_patterns: Page Object Model (POM) pattern - Class represents a UI page with encapsulated element interactions
Swipe-to-find pattern - Multiple methods implement iterative swiping with configurable max_swipes to locate elements in scrollable views
Explicit wait pattern - All methods use timeout parameters for element synchronization
Exception handling pattern - Methods use raise_e flag to control whether to raise exceptions on element not found
Conditional interaction pattern - Methods like click_feature_unavailable_popup_if_exist and click_add_device_btn_if_exist check element existence before interaction
Fallback mechanism - click_add_device_btn implements coordinate-based clicking as fallback when element locator fails
Text extraction pattern - Methods like get_product_number_value and get_product_serial_number_value retrieve text from UI elements
Boolean return pattern - Many click methods return True on success for test assertion purposes
Driver abstraction - All element interactions go through self.driver wrapper methods (wait_for_object, click, get_text, swipe)
Mobile gesture support - Uses mobile:clickGesture for coordinate-based interactions
Verification methods - Multiple verify_* methods for element presence validation
Navigation methods - Methods like navigate_to_product_information_details handle multi-step navigation flows
Tile-based UI interaction - Multiple methods target tile elements suggesting a tile-based UI design
Printer-specific functionality - Methods cover printer operations like scan, print, copy, fax, and printer information retrieval
ui_behaviors: Scrollable tile-based interface requiring swipe gestures to access different printer functions
Modal popups for feature unavailability that need conditional handling
Multi-screen navigation flow for printer information and reports
Print job status tracking with progress and success states
Camera scan integration for document capture
Shortcuts management for quick access to common tasks
Product information display including serial numbers and model numbers
Print quality tools and reports generation
unique_implementation_details: Hardcoded coordinate fallback (341, 957) in click_add_device_btn suggests handling of dynamic or problematic element
Variable max_swipes parameter (3 or 5) depending on expected element depth in scrollable view
Inconsistent parameter ordering in some methods (raise_e before timeout vs timeout before raise_e)
Method click_add_device_btn_if_exist targets 'add_run_shortcut_btn' locator despite method name suggesting 'add_device_btn'
Extended timeout (20 seconds) for click_choose_an_available_printer_btn suggesting network or discovery operation
Two-step interaction in click_choose_an_available_printer_btn (wait then click) vs single-step in other methods
Flow name class attribute 'hpx_printer_details' suggests HPX (HP Experience) platform integration
Inherits from SmartFlow base class indicating framework-specific implementation
No explicit __init__ method - relies on parent class initialization
Locators passed as string identifiers rather than stored as class attributes, suggesting external locator repository
